static_traits.name: Chen Shan
static_traits.social_status: Friendships and social interactions affected by their feeling alienated, daily Reduced socializing
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy; no similar problem history in this situation before
static_traits.language_features: Clear language, good logic, high cooperation, neutral tone; able to describe specific situations and feelings, accompanied by Anxiety and self-worry; tending toward rationalization and downplaying problems

basic_info.main_problem: I believe people distance themselves from me because I love reading <Harry Potter>, thinking it is because the series is no longer popular. This belief makes me feel socially isolated and alienated; in recent months I noticed some acquaintances keeping their distance, so I am more Withdrawn in social settings and fear Being rejected.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize my assumptions about being alienated are affecting my social life and overall well-being; I hope through recording and behavioral experiments to test and correct these thoughts and see the real results to reduce the distress.

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others
I am not competent at Work, mistakes will bring serious consequences

special_situations.event: When talking about <Harry Potter> at Social gatherings, noticing some acquaintances keeping their distance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my interests do not match popular preferences, I will be excluded, not worthy of being liked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing personal interests in Social situations, Reduced socializing interaction to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are avoiding me because I like 'Harry Potter'

special_situations.event: In recent months, notices some acquaintances reduce interaction with me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others distance themselves from me, it must be because my interests are outdated or not recognized
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to Rationalize and downplay in mind, but more Withdrawn in reality, reducing expression
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone no longer likes being with me

special_situations.event: On days with heavy work tasks and important reports to submit, game-related intrusive thoughts appear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I get Distracted or make mistakes, my boss will think I am incompetent and may fire me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works overtime to remedy, sets gaming-time boundaries, adopts time management techniques
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Any mistake could get me fired

special_situations.event: After submitting a poor-quality report, the boss has not yet given negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Work results are not perfect, it equals incompetence and will be negated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously pressures oneself, strives to prove oneself, avoids talking about true feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The boss will think I cannot do it

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and recognized, while freely expressing and holding onto personal interests
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and negative evaluation, being seen as unsociable or incompetent, even losing Work
defense_goal: Avoiding rejection and judgment through Withdrawal and reduced exposure
Maintaining security and control through over-effort and Self-monitoring
Repressing self-expression in social settings to lower risk

object_relations.self_representation: An alienated bystander, a person who needs to act carefully
object_relations.object_representation: Others are picky judges who may distance themselves from me because of my interests
The boss as a harsh examiner, ready to negate me at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks 'what evidence supports your worry' or challenges its assumptions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting the judging experience from others (boss/peers) onto the counselor, feeling oneself being scrutinized and negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a calm, rational tone to list reasons and assumptions, emphasizing objective analysis, reducing emotional expression to lower discomfort.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to concretely describe present emotions or admit the Fear of Being rejected
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries directly expressing feelings will lead to being judged or losing control, so tends to keep distance
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Mainly describing facts and plans, with a restrained tone, quickly shifting from the emotional level to tasks and details.

manifestations: Proactively Withdrawing at Social gatherings from worrying interests will not be recognized
Although having a few friends to talk to, unwilling to share specific distress
outcomes: Overall decline in sense of well-being

manifestations: Feels conflict between 'truly expressing interests' and 'seeking others' acceptance'
Choosing to Repress oneself to avoid Being rejected

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Repeatedly worrying that any mistake will lead to being fired
Speaking cautiously, afraid of being judged
Emphasizes in sessions the need to prove himself and maintain control

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to do a certain behavior toward other people or things, turning the energy originally wanting to go outward toward the self.
manifestations: Not discussing personal interests in Social situations
Turns disappointment at others' distance into self-blame and guilt

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Uses rational analysis and downplaying to avoid directly touching emotions
Avoiding deep feelings through topic Displacement or generalization

positive_force: Still has a few friends as support resources
Willing to try new methods and cooperate with records and behavioral experiments
Strong sense of work responsibility (still working overtime to finish reports while distracted)
Having self-awareness, able to identify the relationship between stress and avoidance
negative_force: Overly concerned with others' opinions and mind reading
Catastrophizing and fear of being fired
Social avoidance and self-Repression leading to isolation
Attention easily drawn to games to escape pressure

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and Repressing self-expression (especially avoiding discussing personal interests)
antecedent: At Social gatherings or when interacting with people who do not share the same interests
When noticing acquaintances growing distant or interacting less
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing rejection from interests not being recognized, forming personalized and overgeneralized cognitions
target_behavior.function: Escaping judgment or Being rejected, gaining short-term security
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening Social isolation, increased alienation and Loneliness, overall Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Distracted attention at Work and repeatedly occurring game-related intrusive thoughts, accompanied by Significant anxiety
antecedent: When work tasks are heavy and deadlines approach
When feeling Increased stress or needing high-intensity focus
target_behavior.core_reason: Using games as a psychological escape route from stress; catastrophic cognition about mistake consequences intensifying Anxiety and Distraction
target_behavior.function: Short-term self-soothing and escaping work stress
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work efficiency, needing overtime to remedy, rising Fear of being fired
